description: This file defines the TimesheetDecorator class, a decorator for the Timesheet entity, providing formatted date output and methods to set related Employee entities, tailored for use within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: TimesheetDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for the Timesheet entity that provides formatted date outputs, a method to set an Employee by employee number, and retrieves the timesheet's state formatted as title case.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with a Timesheet entity.

methods.name: getStartDate
methods.description: Returns the start date of the timesheet formatted as a string.

methods.name: getEndDate
methods.description: Returns the end date of the timesheet formatted as a string.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmployeeNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee associated with the timesheet based on an employee number.

methods.name: getTimesheetState
methods.description: Returns the current state of the timesheet as a string in title case.
